"""Gradio entry point for the campus shuttle Merge Sort simulator.""" from pathlib import Path import gradio as gr from display import message, render_step from ranking import EXAMPLE, MAX_COUNT, MAX_STOPS, build_steps def show(steps, index=0, notice=""): """Show one step and enable the buttons that can move away from it.""" if steps: last = len(steps) - 1 index = max(0, min(index, last)) picture = render_step(steps, index) can_go_back = index > 0 can_go_forward = index < last else: index = 0 picture = notice or message("Ready for a new run", "Choose Start simulation to rank the edited stop counts.") can_go_back = False can_go_forward = False return ( (steps, index), picture, gr.Button(interactive=can_go_back), gr.Button(interactive=can_go_forward), gr.Button(interactive=can_go_forward), ) def start(text): try: steps = build_steps(text) except ValueError as error: return show([], notice=message("Check your input", str(error), error=True)) return show(steps) def editing(): # The textbox has changed. Its previous ranking no longer describes the input. return show([]) def previousStep(session): steps, index = session return show(steps, index - 1) def nextStep (session): steps, index = session return show(steps, index + 1) def showResult(session): steps = session[0] return show(steps, len(steps) - 1) def buildApp(): example_steps = build_steps(EXAMPLE) with gr.Blocks(title="Shuttle Stop Crowd Ranking", analytics_enabled=False) as app: # Gradio gives each browser session its own copy of the trace and cursor. session = gr.State((example_steps, 0)) gr.HTML( '<header class="masthead"><h1>Shuttle stop crowd ranking</h1>' '<p>Use Merge Sort to decide where to send an extra campus shuttle.</p></header>' ) with gr.Row(elem_id="workspace"): with gr.Column(scale=2, min_width=265, elem_id="controls"): entry = gr.Textbox( value=EXAMPLE, label="Stop counts", lines=5, max_lines=14, info=f"Enter 1–{MAX_STOPS} stops, one per line. Use a name, a comma, and a count from 0 to {MAX_COUNT}.", ) start_button = gr.Button("Start simulation", variant="primary") gr.HTML('<p class="input-help">Use Next step to explore the sample, or edit the rows and choose Start simulation.</p>') with gr.Column(scale=4, min_width=310, elem_id="viewer"): picture = gr.HTML(render_step(example_steps, 0), elem_id="picture") with gr.Row(elem_id="navigation"): back = gr.Button("Back", interactive=False, min_width=65) forward = gr.Button("Next step", variant="primary", min_width=94) finish = gr.Button("Show result", min_width=112) outputs = [session, picture, back, forward, finish] # Process input edits, restarts and navigation in the order they arrive. entry.change(editing, None, outputs, show_progress="hidden", concurrency_id="simulation") start_button.click(start, entry, outputs, show_progress="hidden", concurrency_id="simulation") back.click(previousStep, session, outputs, show_progress="hidden", concurrency_id="simulation") forward.click(nextStep , session, outputs, show_progress="hidden", concurrency_id="simulation") finish.click(showResult, session, outputs, show_progress="hidden", concurrency_id="simulation") return app if __name__ == "__main__": theme = gr.themes.Base(primary_hue="teal", neutral_hue="slate", font=["Inter", "system-ui", "sans-serif"]) buildApp().launch(theme=theme, css_paths=Path(__file__).with_name("style.css"), footer_links=[]) """Read crowd estimates and rank shuttle stops with Merge Sort.""" MAX_STOPS = 12 MAX_COUNT = 999 MAX_NAME = 40 MAX_TEXT = 2000 EXAMPLE = """Stauffer Library, 18 West Campus, 32 Athletics Centre, 32 Union Street, 7""" def parse_stops(text): """Turn each nonblank 'name, count' line into a dictionary.""" if text is None: text = "" if len(text) > MAX_TEXT: raise ValueError(f"Use at most {MAX_TEXT} characters for one run.") stops = [] first_seen = {} for line_number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1): if line.strip() == "": continue if len(stops) == MAX_STOPS: raise ValueError(f"Use up to {MAX_STOPS} stops. Remove the extra row on line {line_number}.") parts = line.split(",") if len(parts) != 2: raise ValueError(f"Line {line_number} needs one comma, for example Library, 18.") name = " ".join(parts[0].split()) count_text = parts[1].strip() if name == "" or len(name) > MAX_NAME: raise ValueError(f"Line {line_number} needs a stop name of 1–{MAX_NAME} characters.") if not count_text.isascii() or not count_text.isdecimal(): raise ValueError(f"Line {line_number} needs a whole number from 0 to {MAX_COUNT}.") count = int(count_text) if count > MAX_COUNT: raise ValueError(f"Line {line_number} exceeds {MAX_COUNT} people. Check the estimate.") # Keep the original line number so a duplicate can point to both estimates. key = name.casefold() previous_line = first_seen.get(key) if previous_line is not None: raise ValueError( f"Line {line_number} repeats the stop on line {previous_line}. Keep one estimate per stop." ) first_seen[key] = line_number stops.append({"name": name, "count": count}) if len(stops) == 0: raise ValueError("Enter at least one stop, for example Library, 18.") return stops def explain_pick(chosen, other): if chosen["count"] == other["count"]: return ( f"Both stops have {chosen['count']} waiting. Take {chosen['name']} from the left " "because it appeared earlier in the input." ) return ( f"{chosen['name']} has {chosen['count']} waiting and {other['name']} has " f"{other['count']}. Take {chosen['name']} next." ) def merge(left, right, steps): """Walk through two already-ranked halves, adding the busier front stop each time.""" merged = [] left_index = 0 right_index = 0 while left_index < len(left) and right_index < len(right): # Save the two groups as they looked before this choice, for the Back button. left_before = left[left_index:] right_before = right[right_index:] left_stop = left[left_index] right_stop = right[right_index] # The left half came earlier in the input, so it wins equal counts. if left_stop["count"] >= right_stop["count"]: merged.append(left_stop) left_index += 1 note = explain_pick(left_stop, right_stop) else: merged.append(right_stop) right_index += 1 note = explain_pick(right_stop, left_stop) steps.append({ "kind": "pick", "note": note, "left": left_before, "right": right_before, "output": merged.copy(), }) # One half has run out. The other half is already in dispatch order. left_tail = left[left_index:] right_tail = right[right_index:] if left_tail: side = "left" merged.extend(left_tail) else: side = "right" merged.extend(right_tail) steps.append({ "kind": "tail", "note": f"Only the {side} group has stops left. Append them in the order shown.", "left": left_tail, "right": right_tail, "output": merged.copy(), }) return merged def merge_sort(stops, steps): """Return stops from busiest to quietest and save each step for the screen.""" if len(stops) <= 1: if stops: steps.append({ "kind": "single", "note": "A group with one stop needs no comparisons.", "output": stops.copy(), }) return stops.copy() middle = len(stops) // 2 left_half = stops[:middle] right_half = stops[middle:] steps.append({ "kind": "split", "note": "Divide this group at the middle. Work through the left half first.", "left": left_half, "right": right_half, }) left = merge_sort(left_half, steps) right = merge_sort(right_half, steps) return merge(left, right, steps) def dispatch_decision(ranked): name = ranked[0]["name"] count = ranked[0]["count"] if count == 0: return "Keep the extra shuttle on standby. Every stop reported zero people waiting." if len(ranked) > 1 and count == ranked[1]["count"]: return ( f"Send the extra shuttle to {name}. The highest count is {count}. " "Of the stops tied for first, this one was entered earliest." ) return f"Send the extra shuttle to {name}. Its count of {count} is the highest reported." def build_steps(text): stops = parse_stops(text) steps = [{ "kind": "start", "note": "Read the stops in the order entered. The numbers are people waiting.", "output": stops, }] ranked = merge_sort(stops, steps) steps.append({"kind": "done", "note": dispatch_decision(ranked), "output": ranked}) return steps """Draw one saved Merge Sort step in the Gradio window.""" from html import escape TITLES = { "start": "Input order", "split": "Split the group", "single": "One stop is already sorted", "pick": "Compare the front stops", "tail": "Append the remaining stops", "done": "Final ranking", } def group(title, stops, tone, front=False, added=0): """Label the front candidate and any stops just added to the merged list.""" cards = [] for index, stop in enumerate(stops): marker = "" if front and index == 0: marker = "Front" elif index >= len(stops) - added: marker = "Added" tag = "" card_style = "stop " + tone if marker: tag = f"<small>{marker}</small>" card_style += " marked" # A name such as "Hall <A>" should appear exactly as the user typed it. name = escape(stop["name"]) count = stop["count"] cards.append(f'<li class="{card_style}">{tag}<span>{name}</span><b>{count}</b></li>') if cards: content = '<ol class="cards">' + "".join(cards) + "</ol>" else: content = '<p class="empty-group">Empty group</p>' return f'<section class="group"><h3>{title}</h3>{content}</section>' def ordered_rows(stops, final): """Print the names and counts in order. Scale result bars to the largest count.""" rows = [] for position, stop in enumerate(stops, start=1): name = escape(stop["name"]) count = stop["count"] bar = "" if final: largest = stops[0]["count"] width = 0 if largest > 0: width = 100 * count / largest bar = (f'<span class="track" aria-hidden="true">' f'<span style="width:{width:.2f}%"></span></span>') rows.append( f'<li><span class="position">{position:02d}</span>' f'<span class="stop-name">{name}{bar}</span><b class="count">{count}</b></li>' ) heading = "As entered" if final: heading = "Dispatch order" return (f'<div class="list-label"><span>{heading}</span><span>People waiting</span></div>' f'<ol class="stop-list">{"".join(rows)}</ol>') def render_step(steps, index): step = steps[index] kind = step["kind"] if kind == "start" or kind == "done": visual = ordered_rows(step["output"], final=(kind == "done")) elif kind == "single": visual = group("Sorted group", step["output"], "output") else: comparing = kind == "pick" left = group("Left group", step["left"], "left", front=comparing) right = group("Right group", step["right"], "right", front=comparing) visual = f'<div class="halves">{left}{right}</div>' if kind == "pick" or kind == "tail": added = 1 if kind == "tail": added = len(step["left"]) + len(step["right"]) visual += group("Merged after this step", step["output"], "output", added=added) note_style = "step-note" if kind == "done": note_style = "decision" return ( '<article class="board">' f'<div class="progress-label">Step {index + 1} of {len(steps)}</div>' f'<progress value="{index + 1}" max="{len(steps)}" aria-label="Simulation progress"></progress>' f'<h2>{TITLES[kind]}</h2><p class="{note_style}">{escape(step["note"])}</p>' f'{visual}</article>' ) def message(title, detail, error=False): role = "status" style = "board" if error: role = "alert" style = "board error" return f'<article class="{style}" role="{role}"><h2>{escape(title)}</h2><p>{escape(detail)}</p></article>' from app import buildApp buildApp().launch()
